structured_output.mechanisms: Time scales with total samples processed (steps × batch size) times a width factor (mid-layer channels dominate), reduced by low-resolution phases. Accuracy rises with effective epochs (from steps, not the epochs label) and width, falls with heavy augmentation (cutout, translate4), and falls slightly with low-res fraction. Label smoothing near 0.1 is best, and Muon adds accuracy and some time. Some runs, such as E016, are unexplained outliers.
